title: Boundary identification and forward unit-divisor comparison
statement: Let k be contained in k prime, both algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], and let C be a smooth affine connected curve [def-sc-curves] with smooth proper connected compactification c [lem-sc-compactification]. Both compactifications are integral and Noetherian. There are restriction maps from global sections to the function fields compatible with every germ, and an equivalence of the boundary closed points sending each point to the unique point above it. Under the induced divisor transport [def-sc-divisor], the boundary divisor of every pulled-back unit equals the transported boundary divisor of that unit. This asserts only the forward comparison, not descent of all unit divisors.

proof.text: Construct both restriction ring homomorphisms with the inverse open-immersion appIso followed by germToFunctionField. Naturality of germs and injectivity of each stalk map prove all the compatibility clauses. Nonemptiness of the base-changed source follows from surjectivity of the first projection, since the map between the spectra of the fields is surjective. These are the proved private helper exists_open_restriction and the initial part of the main Lean proof.

For the given compactification [lem-sc-compactification], the complement of the nonempty image open consists of closed points by dimension one. Scheme.range_snd_of_isPullback identifies the new complement with its inverse image. Mathlib pointOfClosedPoint and the proved library baseChangeFieldPoint construct a closed rational point above every old closed point. baseChangeFieldPoint_eq_of_fst_eq gives uniqueness among all points in that fibre. The explicitly defined first-projection map on boundary points is bijective; its inverse gives the required equivalence and the two asserted fibre properties. No enumeration or finiteness of the boundary is needed.

At each matching boundary pair apply [lem-sc-local-dvr-base-change] and use fibre uniqueness to identify its point with the boundary equivalence. In rational_pullback_germ, dominance identifies the generic points and stalk-specialization naturality gives the canonical function-field map. IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext identifies that map with the supplied map from the boundary stalk. Germ naturality then gives its action on open sections. In open_restriction_natural, appLE composition through the commutative square and appIso_inv_appLE identify the pulled-back restriction with the restriction of the pulled-back section. Apply the local order comparison to the unit mapped by the first restriction. Scheme.div_apply [def-sc-divisor], subtypeDomain_apply, equivMapDomain_apply and Finsupp.ext turn the pointwise equality into the required divisor transport equality, also for an empty boundary.

theorem affine_unit_divisor_base_change_core
    (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] [Algebra k k']
    (C : Scheme.{u}) (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C]
    (c : Compactification f) [IsConnectedCurve c.g] [Smooth c.g]
    [IsIntegral c.Z] [IsNoetherian c.Z]
    [IsIntegral (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z]
    [IsNoetherian (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z] :
    ∃ (φ : Γ(C, ⊤) →+* c.Z.functionField)
      (φ' : Γ(CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))), ⊤) →+*
        (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.functionField),
      (∀ (x : C) (s : Γ(C, ⊤)) (y : c.Z.presheaf.stalk (c.i.base x)),
        c.i.stalkMap x y = C.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial s →
          φ s = algebraMap (c.Z.presheaf.stalk (c.i.base x)) c.Z.functionField y) ∧
      (∀ (x : (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) :
          Scheme.{u}))
        (s : Γ(CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))), ⊤))
        (y : (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.presheaf.stalk
          ((c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.base x)),
        (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.stalkMap x y =
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).presheaf.germ
              ⊤ x trivial s →
          φ' s = algebraMap
            ((c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.presheaf.stalk
              ((c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.base x))
            (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.functionField
            y) ∧
    ∃ e : {P : closedPoints c.Z // P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base} ≃
        {P : closedPoints (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z //
          P.val ∉
            Set.range (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.base},
      (∀ P : {P : closedPoints c.Z // P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base},
        (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst c.g
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).base
            (e P).val.val = P.val.val ∧
          ∀ Q : (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z,
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst c.g
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).base Q =
              P.val.val → Q = (e P).val.val) ∧
      (∀ u : Γ(C, ⊤)ˣ,
        Finsupp.subtypeDomain
            (fun P : closedPoints (c.baseChange
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z ↦
              P.val ∉
                Set.range (c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).i.base)
            ((c.baseChange (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).Z.div
              (Additive.ofMul (Units.map φ'.toMonoidHom
                (Units.map (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst f
                  (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom
                  u)))) =
          Finsupp.domCongr e
            (Finsupp.subtypeDomain (fun P : closedPoints c.Z ↦ P.val ∉ Set.range c.i.base)
              (c.Z.div (Additive.ofMul (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom u)))))
